rewrites.comment: expo-router runs as a client-side SPA (app.json web.output = single), so every route must fall through to index.html. Vercel serves real files from dist/ first, so /_expo/static/** and /assets/** still resolve.

headers.comment: Hashed bundle and asset filenames are immutable, so cache them hard.
Fonts are fingerprinted by Metro and are safe to cache long-term.
